comment: She is okay for chemistry but very disorganized and lectures could be confusing. She would get simple problems wrong frequently, however, she provided helpful homework problems and practice materials, which made the exams fair and understandable. I would take again for credit, but if you can get a different professor I would try to.

She's a great professor. Homework was tough, but exams were fine and reflected practice problems. She was available over email to ask questions and held review sessions before exams. She could be disorganized at times, but overall I felt she really wanted us to learn and succeed.

Dr. Parish knows just about everything there is to know about p-chem. The class and material themselves were difficult and that isn't going to change from teacher to teacher itself. Tests were always fair and covered exactly what was expected. Homework could be hard but she encourages the use of AI which was really helpful.

Might just be 141, but it would've been hard w/o prior chem experience. She is super caring, I recommend going to her office hours. Found her to be a little disorganized/she'd go on tangents often which made stuff more confusing. Exam corrections were a lifesaver-probably would've done way worse w/o them. I like her as a person, so it was bearable

she is VERY accessible outside of class. 50% back on tests helped because avgs were very low but if you do practice tests and homework with care you'll be prepared for tests. go to office hours and make a relationship with her and you'll do way better. really great for lab- she cut out things that were confusing or unnecessary.

This class was difficult if you did not have prior chemistry experience. Most of her exam averages were a D, but she gave test corrections to help improve your grade. I do like Dr. Parish as a person and she wants you to succeed, she just should not teach gen chem, she should teach higher levels. Develop a relationship with her in office hours.
def cares about her students
She pushes you hard so you learn a lot but then grades generously. Take her class!
She cares about her students and really wants to make sure that they are prepared for their next science courses

Professor Parish gave me a great foundation of chemistry and I enjoyed the class. She really cares about her students and even though the test averages were low the 50% back for corrections save you. This class is great for pre health but if you are looking for an easy ged look elsewhere. She is a very sweet person and also brought cookies!

We had exam averages far below other classes, as she has a harder curriculum and grades harshly, especially with labs. She doesn't publish ANY grades and has poor study resources. She offers 50% back on tests which saved us. She generally knows the material well and is good for lab. In summary, her class is unnecessarily hard, take another section.

Failed to adequately teach first-years, much more suited for higher level classes. Coursework was unreasonably hard compared to other courses, and doing well on a test was hard, despite proper preparation. Allowed for 50% back, a grade booster, but learning in this class was very difficult due to such fast-paced lectures.

Lecture notes were a disaster, not sure how we were supposed to learn anything from them. Allowed for up to 50% of your missed points back with test corrections which is what saved me. She was available outside of class for help if you asked for it. 

Good for lab. Not so good for lecture.

Terrible. Just the most extra professor I have ever had. Incredibly unreasonable and annoying. She thinks her job is to teach you life lessons instead of actual chemistry, which she doesn't do well. She is exactly the kind of teacher you don't want in college because they will make you hate science forever.

Very nice and cool, but moves faster through the material than any professor I've ever had. If you have the courage to raise your hand and tell her to slow down, she will, but she gives off that "don't mess with me" aura. Her knowledge of the material is outstanding. If she can't answer a question, she will find out and tell the class the next day.
She refused to help me when I went to office hours. She almost made me cry.

Very helpful and not very hard. She can be very strict with chem concepts and there's no way around it, but she provides all the guidance you need so you know exactly what she wants from you. Always interested in her students and always around for any help.
Parish is really nice and helpful and wants everyone to do well.  Tests are hard, but she provides as much help as needed and always makes herself available.

Professor Parish is the best professor I have ever had, not only at U Richmond but anywhere!  She's been a great mentor and teacher.  Her advice is invaluable and I would highly recommend that you join her research group.
